text:
sophie: quick sync note 52 proposing a "handoff-proxy" pattern to replace persistent sidecars for hosted routing. proxy does capability negotiation and returns an ephemeral runtime lease, then either proxies or tunnels the stream. want quick takes on perf, security, and how to opt private deployments out.

raj: ok but biggest worry is blast radius for a multitenant proxy. do we run per-az pools or global?

sophie: per-region AZ-local pools to keep network egress predictable. proxy is stateless aside from ephemeral leases stored in control-plane cache. no long-term secrets on proxy.

elaine: manifest changes? private installs shouldn't be forced to implement anything. make it an optional runtime.handoff block.

sophie: yep optional, sample: {"runtime":{"handoff":{"prefer":["handoff-proxy","direct"],"max_ttl_s":120}}} (we'll include in RFC).

kevin: perf note 1 latency-sensitive paths need tunnel mode (negotiate then TCP tunnel) not full proxy. also need billing tags in handshake so runtime can attribute cost even when tunneled.

raj: security controls: mTLS between proxy and runtime, short-lived PoP tokens for client->proxy, and replay-detection telemetry.

elaine: rollout ops: canary by region + tenant opt-in flag; also global kill-switch feature-flag. private control-planes can ignore the field.

infra-bot: created checklist PR: https://infra/repo/hand-off-proxy/PR-99 52 includes mTLS cert rotation, canary plan, feature flag, dashboards.

sophie: failure modes: if proxy pool is degraded, SDKs can fallback to pinned direct runtime when available; hosted non-pinned tenants get degraded model variant via control-plane proxy. add circuit-breaker on proxy.

kevin: testing matrix: latency tunnel vs proxy, failover to direct, credential rotation midstream, billing attribution. I'll own the perf tests.

elaine: also add an audit to prove proxies store no long-lived secrets.

sophie: thanks all 5b6 will draft RFC w/ sequence diagrams and SLO targets. ping here if you want changes before I post.
